start: A gym member: phone that just updated from an older version to one with a new feature that has its own Settings page

steps.action: Look at the bottom tabs
user_sees: One small dot on the Profile tab; no number
must_not: A dot on a tab that leads to nothing new
A count or a badge with a number

steps.action: Open Profile
user_sees: A small dot on the Settings button
must_not: No dot to follow from here

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: A small dot on the new feature's row
must_not: Dots on rows that have nothing new

steps.action: Open the feature's page
user_sees: A small dot beside the feature's heading; the screen reader says 'New'
must_not: A dot that takes a tap meant for the row or button under it

steps.action: Go back to Settings, Profile and the tabs
user_sees: The row, button and tab dots are gone (unless another new feature sits under them)
must_not: A dot still showing for a feature already opened

start: A gym member: first install of the app (no older version ever on this phone)

steps.action: Open the app and look at the tabs, Profile and Settings
user_sees: No dots anywhere
must_not: Dots for features that are not new to a first-time user

steps.action: On a phone where the new page does not show (Health apps without Health Connect; Notifications or Widgets on an iPhone)
user_sees: No dot for that feature
must_not: A dot trail that ends at a page or row that is not there

steps.action: On a phone whose saved list of seen features cannot be read
user_sees: No dots at all
must_not: Dots that can never be cleared

start: A gym member: updated phone with four new features, none opened

steps.action: Look for dots
user_sees: Dots for the three newest features only
must_not: More than three features lit at once

steps.action: Open one feature's page, leave it, open it again
user_sees: The dot beside the heading shows on the first visit and is gone on the second
The fourth feature now gets its dots
must_not: The heading dot gone before the member could see where the feature is

steps.action: Do not open the others; open the app 30 days after their release date (India time)
user_sees: No dots
must_not: Dots on a feature older than 30 days
Dots returning for an old feature a year later on the same date

steps.action: Close the app and open it again after opening a feature
user_sees: Its dots stay gone
must_not: Seen dots coming back after a restart
